name: Lowi
verdict: Lowi is a telecom brand of Vodafone España, wholly owned by Zegona Communications Plc (UK-listed) since 31 May 2024. No state owner identified. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Owner record updated - Lowi belonged to Vodafone Group Plc until Zegona Communications completed the 100% acquisition of Vodafone Spain on 31 May 2024. Private/listed corporate capital only; no state owner appears anywhere in available material.
